scope: live 15_PRODUCTION_CORE against the authoritative 30 zero-error gates
baseline_note: The original 248-element 77.0 audit remains the authoritative element-level baseline. This live gate audit does not fabricate a new 248 score before every element is re-rendered/retested.

gates.title: Runtime
gates.reason: Production-core suite is green (15/15 commands) with zero editor/chart browser console errors, but legacy/canonical engines are not yet all consolidated into that suite.
gates.next_action: Consolidate remaining timeline/diagram/image/wafer/PPT/NiceGUI surfaces into the same zero-console suite.

gates.title: Geometry
gates.reason: Current editor Smart hull, overlap, bounds, zoom and contextual-control geometry pass, but all 248 renderer/layout combinations are not yet exercised.
gates.next_action: Add geometry/property baselines for every canonical renderer and content-density extreme.

gates.title: Typography
gates.reason: Production core enforces an 11px visible-text floor and compact narrative adaptation; full 248-element clipping/wrap/output-profile coverage remains.
gates.next_action: Run all 248 contracts across XS–XL, long labels, localization-like expansion and PPT-safe profiles.

gates.title: Tokens
gates.reason: Static P0 token lint passes and theme semantic colors are tokenized; remaining canonical wave renderers still need consolidation/token purge.
gates.next_action: Port remaining engine renderers through production token layer and reject presentation literals in CI.

gates.title: Accessibility
gates.reason: Current editor controls have names, keyboard paths, focus styling, target floors, reduced-motion handling and measured theme contrast. Full 248 interactive inventory is not yet rendered/tested.
gates.next_action: Generate interactive accessibility fixtures for all Tier-4/interactive contracts and add screen-reader state assertions.

gates.title: Pointer lifecycle
gates.reason: Production editor drag/resize recovery handles pointercancel/capture loss without stuck state; remaining specialized interactive engines are not yet integrated.
gates.next_action: Apply the same pointer-session primitive to timeline/image/diagram specialized interactions and fuzz cancel/lost-capture sequences.

gates.title: Responsive observation
gates.reason: Editor has ResizeObserver and 60–140% zoom invariance; advanced and engineering charts have XS–XL rendering. Remaining engines need live ResizeObserver integration.
gates.next_action: Wire remaining engines to container observation and add resize storms/content mutation tests.

gates.title: Semantic truth
gates.reason: Statistics, pivot and graph cores block invalid inputs and preserve typed/raw semantics, but a universal AI/data eligibility state-machine gate is not yet connected to all 248 elements.
gates.next_action: Build centralized data-eligibility/truth preflight and require every renderer/AI composition path to consume it.

gates.title: Serialization
gates.reason: Canonical editor model round-trips deterministically; stable semantic IDs and exact history round-trip are regression tested.
gates.next_action: Keep serialization tests mandatory as new component-specific canonical fields are introduced.

gates.title: Revision safety
gates.reason: Every production editor mutation uses revision-checked commands and stale base_revision commits are rejected.
gates.next_action: Require future NiceGUI/Python bridge commits to carry the same base_revision contract.

gates.title: Undo/Redo
gates.reason: 100 mixed atomic edits, grouped membership restoration, exact undo and redo are covered by the production store suite.
gates.next_action: Extend command types only through inverse-tested operations/transactions.

gates.title: Connectors
gates.reason: Golden Connector v5 preserved byte-identically (yes) and authoritative Wave 06/07/09/10 QA records zero route/edge-node failures.
gates.next_action: Keep v5 frozen; add production-core replay fixture when DiagramEngine is consolidated.

gates.title: Charts
gates.reason: 12 advanced chart variants and 13 engineering variants have deterministic typed plans, invalid-input blocking and XS–XL browser rendering; the older basic CoreChartEngine family still needs one production renderer boundary.
gates.next_action: Consolidate Wave 04 basic charts with production render-plan/data-reconciliation gates and remove alias-only remnants.

gates.title: Statistics
gates.reason: Numerical backend matches NumPy/SciPy/statsmodels reference fixtures for distributions, regression, DOE, SPC, capability, CUSUM/EWMA and transforms with invalid-input blocking.
gates.next_action: Add additional corporate reference datasets when available; keep tolerances explicit.

gates.title: Tables
gates.reason: Production pivot core preserves typed keys, subtotals/grand totals and deterministic expand/collapse; 1,500 seeded rows reconcile across 423 cells to pandas and 100k-row stress passes. Sort/filter UI and full TableEngine renderer are not yet consolidated.
gates.next_action: Implement typed sort/filter pipeline, virtualized accessible grid renderer and keyboard navigation on the same core.

gates.title: Timelines
gates.reason: Production timeline semantic core now enforces explicit ISO dates or declared durations, FS/SS/FF/SF dependency types and integer lag, dependency acyclicity, schedule consistency, milestone duration and sequence-only no-date semantics. The visual TimelineEngine renderer/editor integration remains to be consolidated.
gates.next_action: Wire all timeline variants to prepareTimeline() before layout, then add calendar-specific and XS–XL visual regression.

gates.title: Diagrams
gates.reason: New graph semantics engine validates DAG/tree/network/flow/state-machine rules before layout; invalid cycles/roots/unknown nodes/nondeterministic transitions block. Sankey now consumes the shared gate, but full DiagramEngine authoring/layout is not yet consolidated.
gates.next_action: Wire all diagram variants to validateGraph() before Golden Connector/layout and add 100-node visual/performance regression.

gates.title: Images
gates.reason: No production asset-relative crop/anchor/annotation model or untrusted SVG/image ingestion policy has been completed.
gates.next_action: Implement asset-relative transform model, crop/zoom invariance tests, and conservative SVG/image sanitization policy.

gates.title: Wafer/Fab
gates.reason: Production coordinate-registration and missing-vs-zero validation for wafer/fab comparisons is not yet implemented.
gates.next_action: Implement wafer coordinate convention/registration validator before any derived comparison renderer.

gates.title: PPT
gates.reason: Web Rich→PPT Safe mappings are not yet implemented for every shipped component. Exact corporate profile certification additionally requires the external sanitized PPTX/output profile.
gates.next_action: Implement native/editable mappings by engine now; certify typography/theme/profile fidelity when corporate sample arrives.

gates.title: Themes
gates.reason: Light/dark/corporate production tokens now pass measured 4.5:1 small-text contrast and 3:1 accent/canvas non-text contrast in editor smoke; full renderer/theme screenshot matrix remains.
gates.next_action: Run all canonical engine visual baselines in all three themes and detect semantic-color drift/orphans.

gates.title: Performance
gates.reason: 200-component retained-DOM budget passes (p95 15.50 ms, heap growth 0.043 MB); 100k-row pivot and 100-node semantic validation pass. A 100-node rendered DiagramEngine benchmark is still missing.
gates.next_action: Add retained 100-node diagram route/layout/render benchmark and CI budgets for large accessible table rendering.

gates.title: Visual regression
gates.reason: Advanced and engineering chart families have XS–XL screenshot baselines and editor smoke screenshot exists; all Tier-4 elements/themes/content-density extremes are not yet covered.
gates.next_action: Build deterministic screenshot matrix keyed by engine × variant × size × theme × density with pixel/structural thresholds.

gates.title: Property fuzz
gates.reason: Deterministic 10,000-case corpus passes (seed 1511506142) and previously exposed a virtualization-tail bug that was fixed; remaining timeline/image/wafer/PPT/bridge engines are not yet in the corpus.
gates.next_action: Extend generators to every new semantic engine and persist any failing seed as a permanent regression fixture.

gates.title: No external runtime dependency
gates.reason: Production core uses local modules/assets/system fonts and browser tests run from bundled local content without CDN/internet runtime dependencies.
gates.next_action: Keep dependency policy build-blocking; vendor only approved local assets if future libraries are introduced.

gates.title: NiceGUI boundary
gates.reason: The semantic-commit contract is defined, but the actual Golden NiceGUI package is not present, so final one-process/one-port bridge integration cannot be certified.
gates.next_action: Implement a renderer-side semantic commit adapter now, then integrate/certify against the supplied Golden NiceGUI shell without Python pointer-frame traffic.

gates.title: Focus continuity
gates.reason: Unrelated model updates preserve active inspector focus and retained-DOM rendering avoids destructive canvas rebuilds.
gates.next_action: Add IME/composition and multi-control focus fixtures as specialized editors are integrated.

gates.title: Security
gates.reason: Current production text/chart rendering escapes dynamic text and does not allow arbitrary AI HTML/CSS, but untrusted SVG/image sanitation/import policy is still missing.
gates.next_action: Add centralized escaping/sanitization utilities and strict SVG/image importer allowlist before ImageMediaEngine integration.

gates.title: Preflight
gates.reason: Editor geometry and several numerical/chart/graph invalid conditions block or warn before output, but there is not yet a universal 248-contract export preflight aggregator.
gates.next_action: Build one preflight aggregator that evaluates every active component contract, semantic engine and output-profile mapping before export.

gates.title: Determinism
gates.reason: Editor serialization, advanced/engineering SVG render plans, pivot fingerprints and graph fingerprints are deterministic under tested inputs; remaining canonical engines and output mappings need renderer-version traceability.
gates.next_action: Add renderer/version IDs to every plan/export artifact and deterministic fixtures for remaining engines.
